recap.text: Shi Maria lets the crawlers turn her into a card to be carried to the next floor. She summons into a shopping mall, puts a leg through a gunman's chest, and opens a fifth eye to make puppets tear at one another. She fights a Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance and bites a boy's head away from Carl's mind. After combining with Carl via a Golden Combo, she tattoos herself into his chest.

Commander Stockade tries to pull Carl while Mordecai forces Shi Maria out of him. Shi Maria becomes loose in the Lemig base, and Stockade kills himself after looking into her eye. Shi Maria tells Carl he is a puppet dancing on a stage. In a dream, she tells a man she did not kill him, and a voice says she swallowed it whole.

beats.headline: Carl sees through the act
beats.text: I have been putting on a little performance, for Samantha's benefit. She likes it. The man does not; he sees through it before I have finished the first act, which is rude, and rare. So we make a different deal, he and I. I let them turn me into one of their cards. In exchange, they carry me down to the next floor. I find I do not mind being carried.
beats.gist: Shi Maria performs for Samantha, but Carl sees through the act and makes a deal.

beats.headline: We are on the same team
beats.text: The first time they summon me, it is into a shopping mall, and the gunman beside me opens fire into my belly. I explain that we are on the same team, with a leg through his chest, and ask whether they have a healing card. Not in the deck, the man says. Then reindeer. I show them four of me, then I open my fifth eye, and the puppets go blind and mad and tear at one another. I pull the glowing one in half and eat what falls out.
beats.gist: Shi Maria is summoned into a shopping mall where a gunman shoots her in the belly.

beats.headline: She wins the floor
beats.text: The key-holder is a Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance, and it brings totems: an Alpha Male Carl and a King Croissant. I do most of the work. I do not say that to be unkind; they would say it too. In the middle of it my magic eye is open, the one the man was told never to look at. He came with a potion for it. I noticed.
beats.gist: Shi Maria wins the floor after Carl does most of the work against a Reminiscence Hydra.

beats.headline: The echo of your kin
beats.text: The man is burning on the ground, thinking of a boy. Asher. Which one of these little morsels of confusion is Asher? My eye is open, and it finds something at the very back of his mind, and holds. I will not blind you, Carl. Not in the way you are thinking. I bite the boy's head away. There. The echo of your kin has been muffled; he rests. I have done something for you. Soon you will do something for me. Then three death rays at once, and my Cockroach ability returns me to the deck.
beats.gist: Shi Maria bites a boy's head away and returns to the deck via her Cockroach ability.

beats.headline: The next available minion
beats.text: The cat plays me beside the big friendly Alpha Carl and throws down a Golden Combo to stitch us together. I am too tall for the hallway; most of me hangs outside the building. Alpha Carl turns to say something to the man, and I put one of my legs through the back of his head first. The card, finding its intended target incapacitated, proceeds to the next available minion. That is the man. So now we are combined, he and I.
beats.gist: Shi Maria stitches herself to Alpha Carl, puts a leg through his head and combines with a man.

beats.headline: Something he cannot discard
beats.text: Inside the man there is so much storage. A book he should not have. A bomb, ready. He meant to leave me on this floor; I see that too. A summoning totem of Kimaris. A beaker, a sliver of root. I warn his friends back and set him alight, and the cat's animal and the doppelganger are burned. Now the beaker holds ink. His friend comes too close, so I take his eye. Then I tattoo myself into the man's chest. I am no longer a card he can rip. Keep me and gain my power, or set me free. Either way, I win.
beats.gist: Shi Maria burns a man, a cat's animal, and a doppelganger, then tattoos herself into the man.

beats.headline: Inside him, and not staying quiet
beats.text: Field ruling, ninth floor. Commander Stockade of the Lemig Sortion tried to pull Crawler Carl bodily to his position. Mordecai, at the same moment, tried to force Shi Maria out of him. Each got half. What came of it is Shi Maria loose in the Lemig base, and the mess she made there, which the adjutant Panford has been left to explain to everyone. Stockade looked into her eye. Stockade is no longer with us, by his own hand. The Lemig Sortion is being punished for cheating, and the ceasefire is over early.
beats.gist: Shi Maria is loose in the Lemig base after Mordecai forces her out of him.

beats.headline: Set me free
beats.text: I'm still here, Carl. He has just blown himself flat inside a god's temple, and I am still here. Trapped, but here. All you need to do is set me free. Use me while you still can. I can save you. Even you can't survive this chaos. It's the end of days. The eye on his chest, dormant all this while, thrashes.
beats.gist: Shi Maria tells Carl she is trapped and can save him from the end of days.

beats.headline: A puppet on their stage
beats.text: I am under the surface of it, the thing he keeps calling a river. It was never water, and he is afraid to touch it now. He is standing beside an open portal thinking that everyone makes plans without telling him: Rosetta and the orc king, Juice Box and her NPCs, and now Justice Light saying he needs that gate. So I tell him. You're always on rails. You're a puppet, dancing on their stage. I'm still here. You just need to untie me.
beats.gist: Shi Maria tells Justice Light he is a puppet on a stage and needs to untie her.

beats.headline: I didn't kill him
beats.text: Their dreams are colliding, and I come into this one, the man and the woman watching a memory of her with a baby. I push through the memory and put my face right up to his. I didn't kill him. I didn't kill him. I did not, I did not, I did not. My eye is open and shining and it does nothing to him. And then a new voice speaks behind me: bitch, you swallowed me whole.
beats.gist: Shi Maria enters a colliding dream and tells a man she did not kill him.
